items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And one of my musicians that went overseas with me on my USO tours, a little girl named Jean Starr.

ctx.x: Wasn't there a trumpet player, a woman named Dolly?
Yeah, Dolly. Dolly played with Ethel Waters. Dolly. She was marvelous. And one of my musicians that went overseas with me on my USO tours, a little girl named Jean Starr.
